posts.title: 64 BCD Cog Carriers
posts.description: Between steeper trails, shorter cranks, and an older body I've been looking for bigger single speed cogs. With 160mm cranks I'm already at a 30-22 gear. I wouldn't mind running bigger rings and cogs on both ends to get less tension on the chain and therefore a longer life and better efficiency.
